In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms that regulate the expression of cytokines in activated T cells
the molecular mechanisms by which the integrin, lymphocytic function-associated antigen- 1 (LFA1) regulates mRNA stability in human T cells.
the mechanisms of T cell activation, particularly with the regulation of gene expression.

the integrin LFA-1, through its engagement to ICAM-1 on the target cell, induces rapid activation of Rac 1 and 2 in T cells.

the Vav- 1, Rac1/Rac2, p38 MAPK, and MKK3 signaling cascade regulates LFA-1-dependent HuR nuclear-to-cytoplasmic translocation and subsequent mRNA stabilization.
